title: JSFL fl.trace() and fl.outputPanel.trace() never appear in the Output Panel UI
description: In packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts, both fl.trace(msg) (line 4098) and fl.outputPanel.trace(msg) (line 4184) only push to state.traces[] — they never call setOutputMessages in Shell.tsx, so JSFL trace output is invisible to the author in the Output panel. The traces are returned in JsflRunResult.traces (visible to the MCP caller) but not surfaced in the authoring UI. Task 1006 claimed to fix outputPanel.trace but left the Output Panel connection unimplemented. Fix: in Shell.tsx, after calling runJSFL, forward result.traces lines to setOutputMessages so they appear in the Output tab. Both runJSFL callback implementations (the JSFL panel at ~line 5118 and the MCP agent bridge at ~line 5280) need the fix. Also switch the Output tab when JSFL produces trace output (mirroring the Test Movie behavior). Also, fl.outputPanel.clear() at line 4188 is a no-op stub and should call a registered clearOutput callback.
